exports.name: query
exports.notes: resolves a real node Promise with a snapshot of held and pending locks; no signal option of its own; node 24+ per the lock

exports.name: request
exports.notes: the only signal-bearing API in worker_threads; requestLock wraps this with a cancelify-signal shape; cancel while waiting aborts the acquisition, cancel while holding cancels the body then releases under shield so the triggering cancel cannot interrupt the release
